claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Olomoucine is a weak, non-selective purine CDK inhibitor that at 2.5 uM is expected to produce little or no cytotoxicity, since its antiproliferative/cytotoxic effects require much higher concentrations (tens of micromolar) and it lacks a dominant off-target killing mechanism.
